text: Dr Pran gave a me wonderful set of crowns and implants for less than half the price in Australia.The  treatment took  three month and it didn't hurt once.Pran is an excellent dentist.Recommend the practice to anyone.

New dentist was not gentle and not courteous.  I really liked the previous female dentist ( Dr. Waratchaya) but will never again see the new male dentist. He was ruff and spoke no English.
Gave 2 stars because
the receptionists were nice.
Uncomplicated, good price and quality. Doctors are kind and clear in their explaination. Foreigners friendly.
I had 8 teeth filled here and it cost 20,000 baht. A month and a half later, one of the composite fillings fell out. I'm so upset. 🥲 …

The service was good, but when I went for a filling, there was an additional charge of approximately 300 to 400 baht per tooth for drilling, which wasn't mentioned when I inquired about the filling price.
We went there today and the dentist checked my wife's tooth for free. He recommended waiting two days and having it treated in Germany, as the timeframe was too short. We made a donation anyway.
It was good. The doctor was lovely; I had a female doctor who explained everything clearly. She gave excellent advice and recommendations, and was very gentle.
It's good, but parking is a bit difficult. Dr. Prach is lovely.
But I liked the counter staff; they were very polite. I give them a 10.
